title: Beyond Data Schedule: Fast LLM Pretraining on Data Mixtures by Loss-Reweighting
abstract: arXiv:2610.32141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models often acquire specialized capabilities through successive pretraining stages, but these gains can come at the cost of forgetting earlier knowledge. In this work, we investigate whether such trade-offs can be improved by changing how strongly each domain contributes to learning while keeping its data exposure fixed. We find that, in controlled knowledge--mathematics experiments, loss reweighting produces a single checkpoint that surpasses the best knowledge and reasoning scores attained along either stage trajectory. This reveals an independent control that data-mixture ratios alone do not capture. Building on this finding, we propose LARE (Loss-Adaptive Reweighting under fixed Exposure), which automatically adjusts domain weights from running loss statistics. Motivated by a theoretical analysis of gradient noise, its normalized inverse-square-root rule balances relative loss scales without changing the sampled mix

translated_title: 超越数据调度：基于损失重加权的混合数据快速LLM预训练
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型通常通过连续的预训练阶段获得专业能力，但这些收益可能以遗忘先前知识为代价。在这项工作中，我们研究了是否可以通过改变每个领域对学习的贡献强度，同时保持其数据暴露量不变，来改善这种权衡。我们发现，在受控的知识-数学实验中，损失重加权产生了一个单一的检查点，其表现超越了沿任一阶段轨迹所能达到的最佳知识和推理分数。这揭示了一种仅靠数据混合比例无法捕捉的独立控制手段。基于这一发现，我们提出了LARE（固定暴露下的损失自适应重加权），它根据运行中的损失统计自动调整各领域权重。受梯度噪声理论分析的启发，其归一化的逆平方根规则在不改变采样混合的情况下平衡了相对损失尺度。
tldr: 提出LARE方法，在保持数据暴露不变的前提下，根据运行中的损失统计自适应地重加权各领域的损失贡献，使单一检查点的知识与推理性能超越多阶段预训练的最佳结果，从而实现更快的LLM预训练。
en_tdlr: LARE adaptively reweights domain loss contributions based on running loss statistics under fixed data exposure, enabling a single checkpoint to surpass the best knowledge and reasoning scores of multi-stage pretraining trajectories for faster LLM pretraining.
